tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Manpower (Sanitary supervisor, Helper and Loaders) services on outsource basis to Kadakola TP

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
The authority reserves right to accept or reject of all tenders without giving any reason

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least continuous two financial years a minimum annual financial turnoverofRs 44.17 Lakhs. Annual turnover certificate issued by Chartered accountant with valid UDIN Number for past 5 years
BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL RELEVANT TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS AS PERCONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT ATTACHED
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 13.25 Lakhs -Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc

Satisfactorily completed at least one Similar works i.e, supply of manpower such as Sanitary supervisor, Helper and Loaders or other sanitation related works of value not less than Rs 22.09 lakhs, as prime contractor
The tenderer should attach ESI and EPF paid challans for the last financial year 2025-26 to should be uploaded
The tenderer should have in his/Firm name Registered GST Certificate. The tenderer should upload last financial year 2025-26 GST clearance certificate/GST payment challans
The tenderer should have valid PF and ESI Registration certificate

The Tenderer should have valid registration certificate issued by Labour department, Government of Karnataka. Form VI issued by the Assst. Commissioner Labour dept should be attached and NOC from labour office
